title: from method reachability to parameter reachability
segments: 6-1 task orchestration: multi-line goal, acceptance criteria, dependencies and the coding switch from a terminal editor
status: 6-1 complete; 6-2 session management, 6-3 task detail, 6-4 real API verification pending; 6-5 packaging is out of scope
scope: stage 5 made all 19 host methods reachable, but the client always sent empty task parameters: `Action::Send` hard-coded acceptance="" and dependencies=[]. 6-1 makes the parameters themselves reachable, so acceptance criteria and dependency gating (queued / blocked, coding tasks needing integrationStatus=integrated) actually reach the host

contract_coverage.note: no new method; `task/create` now carries its full parameter set instead of constants

task_editor.key_correction: Ctrl+I was the original plan but a terminal delivers it as 0x09, the same byte as Tab, so it can never be a distinct binding; Ctrl+F keeps the Ctrl+letter convention used by the other modals
task_editor.fields: 0 goal, 1 acceptance, 2 dependencies, 3 coding; Tab/BackTab cycle, Esc cancels
task_editor.multiline: Enter inserts a newline in the goal and acceptance fields (goal <= 64000 bytes, acceptance <= 16000 bytes); Space is plain text there. Enter on a pane without the editor still dispatches immediately with empty acceptance and no dependencies, byte-for-byte as before
task_editor.acceptance_required: the editor rejects an empty acceptance and keeps the form open, pointing at the Enter quick-dispatch path; the host itself still allows empty acceptance
task_editor.dependencies: candidates come from the current session's task/list; at most 8 (MAX_DEPENDENCIES); failed/cancelled/interrupted/blocked tasks cannot be selected and say so (`勾选后新任务会直接阻塞`); a completed coding task that is not integrated is labelled 等待集成; the window shows 8 rows and scrolls with the cursor
task_editor.coding: the switch starts from the pane's current coding toggle and is sent as `coding` in the same request
task_editor.caret: text fields share TextBuf { text, cursor } with the pane input line, so caret arithmetic exists once; the editor marks the focused field with an inline `❙` instead of moving the terminal cursor, which keeps wrapped lines correct, and a stale cursor is clamped to a char boundary before rendering

dispatch.helper: client.rs::dispatch_task is the single shape for both paths: Action::Send (legacy quick dispatch) and Action::CreateTask (editor) build the same task/create request
dispatch.validation: goal non-empty and within the limit; acceptance non-empty and within the limit; dependency ids are a subset of the rendered candidates; the host stays authoritative and its errors are echoed verbatim with the form still open
dispatch.blocked_events: the client handles task_blocked and appends `[依赖] 任务已阻塞：<host reason>` to the pane in the warning colour

footer: hints moved to two lines: Ctrl+R 刷新 / Ctrl+C 停止 now sit on the first line and Ctrl+F 编排 joins the task line; both lines are asserted to fit 132 columns

suite.ignored_reason: core runtime_e2e needs installed Codex; tui real-host smoke needs a built codex-collab-core
suite.regressions_guarded: the existing panes/input/history tests were kept and only adapted to TextBuf, so Enter dispatch, paste, history and caret editing stay covered

opt_in.real_host_smoke: passed: the ignored test still drives a real codex-collab-core process through session/create, agent/configure, agent/list, task/list, approval/list, task/get, task/integrate, context/compact, agent/testConnection, agent/connectionResult, event/publish and task/output

pty_demo_smoke: passed: four panes, the live-only Ctrl+F stays inert in demo mode and does not steal focus, paste/send, caret editing, stop, confirmed quit, terminal restoration, non-TTY rejection
pty_live_smoke: passed: after seeding a session and agent, Ctrl+F opened the editor, typing rendered the label set and Ctrl+S hint, Enter inserted a newline rather than dispatching, Tab reached acceptance and the dependency list, space on the coding field toggled it, and Ctrl+S produced the queued-task feedback. After the TUI exited, a second host session read the task back and asserted goal == `implement retry with backoff\nsecond line`, acceptance == `tests pass and cancellation is covered`, coding == true, dependencies == [] — the parameters really reached task/create
pty_render_note: ratatui emits only changed cells and the inline caret changes one cell per keystroke, so the live probe strips escape sequences and the `❙` marker before matching contiguous text, and drains until an expected needle appears instead of sleeping a fixed time
screen_snapshot: evidence/stage-6-task-screen.txt is a live 40x132 frame with Ctrl+T queueing a probe task first (so the dependency row is real and shows 前置已失败), a two-line goal, an acceptance line and the caret still in the acceptance field
real_api_blocker: 6-4 needs the provider, endpoint, model, protocol, whether spend is allowed, and who writes the credential through Ctrl+K; until then the connection probe keeps failing without a credential, which is itself visible in the snapshot's failed task row
evidence_script: scripts/stage6_evidence.sh replays build -> workspace tests -> opt-in tests -> clippy -> fmt -> both pty probes -> the task-editor snapshot, and rewrites evidence/stage-6-tests.log
